card.name: Bondar
card.tagline: Ukrainian folk dance of khorovod type (circle dance)
card.profile: Bondar (literally "cooper") is a Ukrainian folk dance of khorovod type (circle dance). Its pattern is based on imitation of the professional movements of the cooper.
card.insight: Bondar (literally "cooper") is a Ukrainian folk dance of khorovod type (circle dance).
